name: United Spirits Ltd. (Diageo India)
business_summary: India's largest spirits company (Diageo India; Diageo plc owns 56.68%): Johnnie Walker, Black Dog, Black & White, VAT 69, Antiquity, Signature, Royal Challenge, McDowell's No.1, Smirnoff, Captain Morgan. Roughly 83% of net sales value (NSV) is Prestige & Above (P&A), the rest Popular (model estimate; Popular fell 22.7% in Q2). Q2 FY27 NSV Rs3,258cr (+2.8%), P&A +6.3%, gross margin 48.0% (+88bp), EBITDA Rs643cr (-4.3%, margin 19.7%), PAT Rs462cr (-2.1%) after a 57% jump in advertising ahead of the festive season; policy changes in Maharashtra and Karnataka hit the Popular segment. TTM sales Rs12,717cr, OPM 18%, ROCE 26%. Market cap Rs1.02 lakh cr; P/E 56; dividend payout 56%.

exposures.mechanism: SSU: +1 = adverse state excise/pricing change on the scale of the Maharashtra and Karnataka changes in FY27 (Popular segment NSV -22.7% in Q2). Popular ~18% of NSV (model estimate) => -4% NSV hit at lower margin => EBITDA ~-3% (Popular margin below group average); x persistence 0.5 x EV/MCap 1.0 => ~-1.8; rounded -2.0. Repeat risk in other states (state-level policy is the dominant idiosyncratic driver).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 NSV Rs3,258cr +2.8%, PAT -2.1% to Rs462cr; P&A +6.3%, Popular -22.7%; gross margin 48.0% (+88bp); EBITDA Rs643cr margin 19.7%
company press release Q2 FY27 (West Asia crisis offset to gross margin; Maharashtra/Karnataka policy changes)

exposures.mechanism: Molasses-based ENA (extra-neutral alcohol/grain neutral spirit) ~40% of COGS = ~20% of NSV; molasses follows sugar with ~0.5 pass-through, so +10% sugar => ENA +4-5% => +0.9% of NSV; ~30% recovered via price (state-regulated MRPs) => 0.63% => EBITDA -3.4% (at 18-19% margin) x persistence 0.4 x EV/MCap 1.0 => -1.3. Sugar +28% since June. Pack: sugar not top-12; gas +0.90 (t 2.6) is likely spurious.

More favourable ethanol policy diverts molasses/grain to fuel ethanol, tightening ENA supply and raising spirit cost: +1 => ENA +3% => ~0.6% NSV => EBITDA -2.5% x 0.4 x 0.8 => -0.8. Grain ENA gives partial hedge.
Grain-based ENA and malt; rice (FCI) used for ethanol. +10% => ENA ~+1.5% => 0.3% NSV => EBITDA -1.6% x 0.4 x 0.8 => -0.5.

Glass bottles ~20-25% of COGS (10-12% of NSV), energy ~30% of glass cost; +15% gas/LNG => +0.5% NSV, 30% recovered => EBITDA -1.9% x 0.3 => -0.6, ranged -1.2..+0.3. The pack shows the OPPOSITE sign (+0.90, t +2.6), which we regard as spurious/risk-on beta (unadjusted); fundamentals dominate but confidence is low.
Cartons, caps, labels ~8% of COGS (4% NSV); +10% => 0.4% NSV, 30% recovered => EBITDA -1.5% x 0.4 => -0.6.
Freight, fuel and PET/plastics ~5% of NSV; +10% Brent => +0.25% NSV => EBITDA -1.2% x 0.4 => -0.5. Q2 gross margin was offset by the West Asia crisis (company release).

evidence.note: company press release Q2 FY27 (West Asia crisis offset to gross margin; Maharashtra/Karnataka policy changes)

exposures.mechanism: Imported Scotch/bulk, concentrates and Diageo royalty/brand fees ~4-5% of NSV; exports small. +3% INR depreciation => cost +0.13% NSV => EBITDA -0.7% x 0.5 => -0.35. Pack shows +2.22 (t +1.8), opposite sign: likely FPI-related market beta; keep fundamental sign, wide range.
Prestige & Above is ~83% of NSV (Q2 P&A +6.3%; double-digit aspiration). +1 => P&A growth +2pp => NSV +1.7% at ~35% incremental margin => EBITDA +3.0% x persistence 0.7 => +2.1.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 NSV Rs3,258cr +2.8%, PAT -2.1% to Rs462cr; P&A +6.3%, Popular -22.7%; gross margin 48.0% (+88bp); EBITDA Rs643cr margin 19.7%

exposures.mechanism: P&A consumption is urban and discretionary. +5pp urban demand => NSV +2% x 35% / 19% margin => EBITDA +3.7% x 0.5 => +1.9-2.0.
56x P/E, 11.3x book, near-zero debt: long-duration; +25bp G-sec => ~-2.5% on multiple at 50% pass-through => -1.3.

evidence.note: India 10y G-sec ~7.4-7.5% in Oct 2026, multi-year high (Reuters/ET headlines); Nov outlook 7.25-7.35%
